audience_note: Built for an agent to drive. The .bat banners are a fallback; never drive them interactively.

artifacts.spec_options: mtp (draft head lives inside the artifact)

commands.start:
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File agent\ninfer-agent.ps1 start -Artifact auto -Port

[-Ctx ] [-Kv auto|fp8|nvfp4|rk4v4|k8v4|int8|bf16] [-Spec auto|mtp|dflash2|none] [-K ]

exit_codes.5: context does not fit in VRAM
exit_codes.6: engine did not become ready (or, in agent mode, a prompt was needed)

config_matrix.note: best measured configuration on a 32 GB 50-series card: 512.9 t/s on highly predictable content, 154.7 t/s on prose
dflash2 weights are about 10.2 GiB; 131072 needs about 4 GiB of fp8 KV
16 GB cards: keep ctx at 32768 and use K=5
small cards: MTP drafts 3 tokens; 4-bit KV (rk4v4 on 8.9, nvfp4 on 12.0) halves the KV term when ctx must grow

env_switches.name: NINFER_AGENT_CC
env_switches.effect: forces the card family in every start-*.bat (8.9 or 12.0) and removes the interactive prompt entirely

env_switches.name: NINFER_AGENT
env_switches.effect: set to 1: the .bat files stop on nothing (no pause; a needed prompt becomes a hard error, exit 6)

env_switches.name: NINFER_TERNARY_S8_MIN_TOKENS
env_switches.effect: int8 rung admission threshold. The crossing point is a property of the CARD (66-SM Ada about 17; 76-SM Ada about 32-40), so it must be measured per card. Same-binary A/B.

env_switches.name: NINFER_TERNARY_WIDE_MIN_TOKENS
env_switches.effect: wide-tile (bf16 mma) admission threshold; same-binary A/B

env_switches.name: NINFER_TERNARY_S8
env_switches.effect: 0 disables the whole int8 rung (changes numerics; A/B only)

env_switches.name: NINFER_TERNARY_S8_DEBUG
env_switches.effect: 1 prints one stderr line per ternary call naming the rung actually taken plus the admission bits; pair with _DEBUG_MIN_T and _DEBUG_BUDGET

env_switches.name: NINFER_TERNARY_MMA
env_switches.effect: 0 disables every tensor-core rung, forcing the SIMT fallback (slower); diagnostic only

env_switches.name: NINFER_TERNARY_PTQ1_FAST
env_switches.effect: 0 with a PTQ1 artifact rejects the mma rungs and is silently slower

env_switches.name: NINFER_SM_COUNT
env_switches.effect: compile-time kTargetSmCount used for wave/occupancy. 120a implies 170 (RTX 5090); other 50-series cards need -DNINFER_SM_COUNT=<their SM count> plus a rebuild. The size of the gain is NOT measured.

faults.cause: engine arch does not match the card (sm_89 on a 50-series card or sm_120 on a 40-series card), or the 7 ffmpeg dlls are missing next to the exe
faults.action: run doctor; start with the engine whose arch matches the reported compute capability; keep exe and dlls together

faults.symptom: one CPU core near 95 percent, GPU idle, no output
faults.cause: same arch mismatch: the engine spins instead of failing cleanly
faults.action: kill it, run doctor, use the matching engine

faults.symptom: FATAL server failed during startup | capacity
faults.cause: the requested context does not fit in VRAM
faults.action: lower --max-context, or use a 4-bit KV dtype (rk4v4 on 8.9, nvfp4 on 12.0)

faults.cause: a dflash2 artifact was started without --lm-head-draft
Ada-only KV dtype requested on a Blackwell card
faults.action: use fp8 (both arches) or nvfp4 (12.0 only)

faults.symptom: candidate token ledger does not match prompt length, then 503 inference engine is unavailable
faults.cause: old engine binary: the prefix-reuse ledger guard is wrong and only fires on the SECOND request reusing the same prefix
faults.action: use the engine in this package (fixed builds reproduce 200/200/200 where the old build gave 200/500/503)

faults.symptom: Option noheader is not recognized, and the card is then called unsupported
faults.cause: old launcher: --format=csv,noheader inside for /f is split into two arguments
faults.action: use this package launchers, or run the launcher self-check

faults.symptom: a stray file appears next to the launcher (for example about or 128K)
faults.cause: banner echo contained an unescaped > which cmd treated as redirection
faults.action: use this package launchers, or run the launcher self-check

faults.symptom: . was unexpected at this time, launcher stops
faults.cause: an unescaped ) in an echo line inside an if-block closes the block early
faults.action: use this package launchers, or run the launcher self-check

faults.symptom: FATAL ... [json.exception.type_error.316] invalid UTF-8 byte 0xBC, or a CreateFileW that shows question marks where your path has CJK
faults.cause: a path handed to the engine contains non-ASCII characters. The model path cannot be opened at all; a --request-log-jsonl path crashes the JSON writer because those bytes are GBK, not UTF-8. Measured twice on 2026-09-26
faults.action: keep the whole package on an ASCII path (any drive and folder name, as long as no CJK appears anywhere above it); the agent CLI already forces its own logs into %TEMP%\ninfer-agent-logs and refuses a non-ASCII artifact path with exit 5

faults.symptom: bench shows a low first run and normal later runs (for example 62 then 212 t/s)
faults.cause: the first request after a cold start runs while the GPU clocks are still ramping
faults.action: discard the first run and take the median of at least three; the agent CLI reports every run so the pattern is visible

faults.symptom: engine path not found, the launcher reports no such command
faults.cause: the executable is ninfer-serve.exe (with the n), not infer-serve.exe
faults.action: run the launcher self-check, which now compares every ENGINE= path against the real files in engine\

faults.symptom: two arms that should differ return the same number
faults.cause: most often the arm never ran (env not applied, wrong binary, value ignored)
faults.action: prove the arm with the rung probe before believing a tie

invariants: Report the content kind with every number: the same card differs by up to 3x between highly predictable content and prose/code.

Report the accept rate with every number. Throughput = step-rate x (1 + K x accept-rate). Step-rate belongs to the card; accept-rate belongs to the content and reproduces to the exact integer across cards.

A/B on ONE binary whenever an env switch exists. When only a rebuild can change the value, alternate the two binaries and verify both sha256 values. Never run them sequentially and call the difference a result.
Discard the first run after a cold start (clocks ramp), then take the median of at least three alternating runs.
Long prompt (at least 1k tokens) and long output (at least 400 tokens), greedy decoding.

The engine log is the authoritative source: read the req#N done line (decode X tok/s, accepted a/b (p percent), cache hit, TTFT) from the stderr log that start returns. The HTTP-side timing includes prefill and the first-token wait, so it understates decode.
Cross-card absolute numbers are not comparable. Cross-card accept rates are.

routing.then: plan, start, bench on the same port, stop
routing.on_coding_workloads: bench -Kind code: accept-rate-limited content. Expect about one third of the predictable-content rate; tune K through 1 + K x accept, not by K alone
routing.on_tuning: sweep for the int8 threshold (same binary); NINFER_TERNARY_WIDE_MIN_TOKENS is a plain env A/B
never: drive a .bat interactively from an agent
trust a tie between two arms without proving the arm ran
report a number without content kind and accept rate
assume the engine matches the card without doctor
